ai.seo_question: What does it mean when the sky trembles on the Day of Judgment?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Al-Tur (77:10) highlights the fragility of the current cosmic order, foreshadowing the Great Revival (Al-Ba'th) where the heavens will shift from their fixed paths. This imagery resonates with the concept of *Naskh al-Ahkam* (abrogation of laws) and the ultimate dissolution of temporal structures, serving as a reminder for believers to prepare for the final accountability under the authority of the Ahl al-Bayt.
